<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Josefin+Sans:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,500;0,600;0,700;1,300;1,400&display=swap">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.5.1/css/all.min.css">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://www.nesports3.com/wp-content/plugins/nesports-pro/assets/css/nesports-frontend.css">
<style>
:root { --hb-accent: #e11d48; --hb-font: "Josefin Sans", sans-serif; }
.hb-hero.e-con { display: block !important; position: relative; overflow: hidden; background: #09090b; padding: 28px 0 64px !important; }
.hb-hero-track.e-con { display: flex !important; flex-direction: row !important; flex-wrap: nowrap !important; gap: 24px !important; transition: transform 0.65s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); will-change: transform; width: max-content !important; max-width: none !important; }
.hb-hero-slide.e-con { width: min(1220px, 86vw) !important; min-width: min(1220px, 86vw) !important; height: 560px !important; position: relative !important; border-radius: 18px !important; overflow: hidden !important; display: flex !important; flex-direction: row !important; align-items: center !important; justify-content: space-between !important; background: #121216 !important; padding: 48px 60px !important; opacity: 0.45; transform: scale(0.96); transition: opacity 0.5s ease, transform 0.5s ease; }
.hb-hero-slide.e-con.is-active { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
.hb-hero-media-wrap.e-con { position: absolute !important; inset: 0 !important; width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; z-index: 1 !important; padding: 0 !important; }
.hb-hero-media-wrap.e-con::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(9,9,11,0.88) 0%, rgba(9,9,11,0.55) 55%, rgba(9,9,11,0.25) 100%); z-index: 2; pointer-events: none; }
.hb-hero-media-wrap .elementor-widget-image, .hb-hero-media-wrap .elementor-widget-container, .hb-hero-media-wrap img { width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; object-fit: cover !important; display: block !important; }
.hb-hero-caption-wrap.e-con { position: relative !important; z-index: 3 !important; max-width: 620px !important; display: flex !important; flex-direction: column !important; gap: 14px !important; align-items: flex-start !important; }
.hb-cat-card-el.e-con { position: relative !important; border-radius: 12px !important; overflow: hidden !important; background: #111 !important; transition: transform 0.35s ease !important; }
.hb-cat-card-el.e-con:hover { transform: translateY(-6px) !important; }
.hb-cat-card-el .elementor-widget-image img { width: 100% !important; aspect-ratio: 4/5 !important; object-fit: cover !important; display: block !important; transition: transform 0.5s ease !important; }
.hb-cat-card-el.e-con:hover .elementor-widget-image img { transform: scale(1.05) !important; }
.hb-prod-card-el.e-con { transition: transform 0.28s ease, box-shadow 0.28s ease !important; }
.hb-prod-card-el.e-con:hover { transform: translateY(-5px) !important; box-shadow: 0 14px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.09) !important; }
.hb-prod-card-el .elementor-widget-image img { width: 100% !important; aspect-ratio: 1/1 !important; object-fit: cover !important; }
@media (max-width: 900px) {
    .hb-hero-slide.e-con { height: 460px !important; padding: 28px 24px !important; }
    .hb-cat-card-el.e-con, .hb-prod-card-el.e-con { width: 48% !important; }
}
</style>
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
    function initKitSlider() {
        var hero = document.getElementById("hb-hero");
        var track = document.getElementById("hb-hero-track");
        var dots = document.querySelectorAll("#hb-hero-dots button");
        if (!hero || !track || !track.children.length) return;
        var idx = 0, timer = null;
        function goTo(i) {
            var s = track.children;
            if (!s.length) return;
            idx = (i + s.length) % s.length;
            var w = s[0].getBoundingClientRect().width;
            var gap = 24;
            track.style.transform = "translateX(" + ((hero.clientWidth - w) / 2 - idx * (w + gap)) + "px)";
            Array.prototype.forEach.call(s, function(el, n) { el.classList.toggle("is-active", n === idx); });
            dots.forEach(function(d, n) { d.classList.toggle("is-active", n === idx); });
        }
        function auto() { clearInterval(timer); timer = setInterval(function() { goTo(idx + 1); }, 6000); }
        dots.forEach(function(d) {
            d.addEventListener("click", function() { goTo(parseInt(d.dataset.slide, 10)); auto(); });
        });
        window.addEventListener("resize", function() { goTo(idx); });
        setTimeout(function() { goTo(0); auto(); }, 150);
    }
    initKitSlider();
    setTimeout(initKitSlider, 800);

    document.querySelectorAll(".hb-kit-pills button").forEach(function(btn) {
        btn.addEventListener("click", function() {
            var parent = btn.closest(".hb-kit-pills");
            parent.querySelectorAll("button").forEach(function(b) { b.classList.remove("is-active"); });
            btn.classList.add("is-active");
            var filter = btn.getAttribute("data-filter");
            var section = btn.closest(".e-con");
            var cards = section ? section.querySelectorAll(".hb-prod-card-el") : document.querySelectorAll(".hb-prod-card-el");
            cards.forEach(function(card) {
                if (filter === "all" || card.classList.contains("cat-" + filter)) {
                    card.style.display = "flex";
                } else {
                    card.style.display = "none";
                }
            });
        });
    });
});
</script>
